name: Meeting Minutes
description: Thorough, structured minutes: what was discussed, what was decided and who does what by when.
outline: Write minutes of the meeting from the transcript; capture everything of substance rather than condensing it into a short summary.
Stick to what was actually said: facts, figures, dates and decisions, without adding interpretation.
Walk through the discussion in the order it happened, one bullet per topic or point raised.
Record each decision separately, in the order it was taken.
Put the agreed work in a table with the columns Task, Owner, Due and Notes; leave a cell empty when the transcript does not say.
List any dates or deadlines that came up as '- **<date or time>**: <what is due>'.
End with the open questions and follow-ups that still need attention.
example:
## Summary
Weekly planning meeting.

## Action Items
| Task | Responsible | Deadline | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
